text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're finally here, ready to take on the
February
Stakes! Most Umamusume
would be shaking in
their boots right
now, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, did you see the size of the crowd?! There's like twice as many as before!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Do you think there's some kind of
special event
today?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Gee one"? That sounds kind of familiar!
choice_data_list: I think there might be a G1 coming up...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What a cool name. I wanna check it out,
too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
After I'm done today, let's go watch it
together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: ...First, go give that race everything you've got!
...First, go give that race everything you've got!
